title: Star Lab Model Manifest
description: Versioning metadata for a published model package. Weights live in safetensors files; this manifest is the cross-runtime contract. v1.1 adds tokenizer_hash/mode and embedding_remap.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version (semver). Separate from model version. 1.0.0 readable; 1.1.0 preferred.

parent_version.description: Lineage: previous model version this was derived from

weights_uri.description: Relative path inside package (model.safetensors or model.safetensors.index.json)

weights_format.description: Weight interchange format (lab standard: safetensors only)

weights_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the primary weights file, or of index+shards concat policy (see docs)

tokenizer_hash.description: Required when tokenizer_id is set — exact revision seal

tokenizer_uri.description: Relative path to tokenizer bundle inside package

tokenizer_mode.description: Mirror of tokenizer package mode; freeze by default

embedding_remap.description: none=same vocab; retrained=embeddings updated for new tokenizer; required_unmet=incompatible

data_version.description: Training data snapshot / dataset version id

code_commit.description: Git commit SHA of training/export code

env_hash.description: Hash of environment lock (python packages, OS, etc.)

body_id.description: Optional Star Lab body that owns this package

metrics.description: Eval metrics at publish time (e.g. accuracy, mae, cost_per_success)

quantization.description: e.g. none, int8, int4, fp16, bf16
